mixless beta.4 adds low-latency macOS output and hardware format controls, improves AutoMix entry selection, and brings MLX-first analysis and an installer with models.

## Changes since beta.3

- Default macOS audio to a 256-frame buffer where supported, adapting to the device's reported limits. Choose a buffer size in Preferences and see the actual callback size and buffer duration.
- Choose the master output's sample rate and physical bit depth from device-supported formats, or follow the current system/device format. Audio is rendered at the selected output rate while preserving source timing and pitch. Preferences distinguish the physical output format from the internal processing stream.
- Verify hardware format changes and restore the previous output on failed configuration. Automatically follow system output/device changes; defer reopening streams during recording to keep the WAV sample rate consistent. Headphones retain their own device format.
- Improve AutoMix incoming-entry checks and musical exit boundaries, keeping complete-set plans stable and respecting manual IN/OUT cues. Improve portable library preparation and missing-file workflows.
- Prefer MLX for stem analysis on compatible Apple Silicon systems, with CoreML and CPU fallback. MLX requires macOS 14 or later; the app still targets macOS 12 or later.
- Refine Preferences and add direct MIDI binding. Provide standard and model-inclusive installers, preserving the installed variant during automatic updates.

## Install or update

Download **Mixless-macOS-0.1.0-beta.4.dmg** for the standard installer, or **Mixless-macOS-0.1.0-beta.4-with-models.dmg** for offline first-use analysis on Apple Silicon. Both contain the same universal Apple Silicon/Intel app and use the same library. The app and DMGs are Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and stapled.

Open the DMG and drag mixless to Applications, or double-click the app to install. Existing beta users can choose **mixless → Check for Updates…**, then restart when prompted. `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies both installers; `mixless-beta-latest.json` supplies the beta updater feed.

[Website and downloads](https://mixless.alkinum.com/#downloads) · [Audio settings guide](https://mixless.alkinum.com/docs/audio) · [音频设置指南](https://mixless.alkinum.com/docs/zh/audio)

## Beta limitations

Supported output rates and depths depend on the device. Audio processing uses floating point; selecting a larger sample rate or bit depth does not recover detail absent from the source or guarantee better listening quality. Applying output settings briefly interrupts playback, and buffer duration is not total output latency.

Physical rate changes at 44.1/48/96 kHz and buffers from 64 to 2048 frames were verified on the development Mac. Physical 16/24-bit output, 176.4/192 kHz output, and separate headphone devices still need validation with suitable hardware; higher-rate rendering has automated coverage.

Analysis and AutoMix choices remain estimates; audition unfamiliar transitions. Functional tests and offline callback budgets do not establish glitch-free playback under every workload. Stem/note inference requires Apple Silicon; including models does not enable inference on Intel. Spotify supplies playlist metadata; playable audio must be available locally.
